verdict: THE REGISTER — not UNION-CLEAN. 2 MAJOR + 4 MINOR. The three artifacts survive hostile re-walk on substance: every seam verdict I re-tested at both ends holds (19 of 24 seams walked, incl. all 9 convictions), the G-F adjudication's arithmetic reproduces cell-for-cell under independent re-derivation (92/604/73; P1 442 lines / 58 records / Σ590; P2 complement 19 rows across exactly the 5 named records with ApiOfflineChip=7), 10 independently drawn NWO rows are all carried at namespace-correct fold coordinates, all 27 runbook gates exist at their cited coordinates, all ordering coordinates I checked resolve, planning-only posture is clean, and E-3 holds by git status. But the runbook of record drops a hard sequencing declaration in the section titled THE ORDER, and one CONSISTENT seam stamp rests on a quotation its own cited command does not produce.

defects.claim: RUNBOOK REALITY — the runbook drops F.W9's declared predecessor chain entirely. F-W9 §State declares three hard predecessors; the runbook's Track C draws F.W9 as a root node with no incoming edge, and no ordering edge into F.W9 exists anywhere in the file. Combined with §1.0 ('the four heads may open together at the begin-word'), an executor reading Track C can open F.W9 beside F.W0. This is the exact class §1's own preamble commits to sourcing.
defects.receipt: `sed -n '15p' /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js/docs/tranches/X/fourier/waves/F-W9.md` → "**Opens after**: F.W0 (substrate pre-gates, hard) → F.W1 (atomic) → F.W3/W4 (the cures this wave gates)."  vs  EXECUTION-RUNBOOK.md:175 `F.W9 ──► F.W10   ── RE-CUT-0 …` drawn at the left margin at the same indent as F.W0/F.W1; `grep -n 'F\.W9' EXECUTION-RUNBOOK.md` → 11 hits, the only §1.3 edge-table row being :195 `| F.W9 ↔ F.W10 | RE-CUT-0 …|` — zero rows cite F.W0/F.W1/F.W3/F.W4 → F.W9. Runbook §1 preamble (:44) names the source as "X·F each `F-W*.md` §State `Opens after`".

defects.claim: SEAMS S-10 (CONSISTENT) rests on a quotation that does not exist in the file and that its own cited command does not return. The seam's substance survives (the 7.0.0 exact devDep IS at both ends), but the register's §Method makes 'quoted by a runnable command' the sole basis for a CONSISTENT stamp — and this stamp's quote is synthesized. It is a worse instance of the class S-19 convicts nine sections later.
defects.receipt: SEAMS.md:322 states ⟨cmd⟩ `grep -n 'AGG-P1' keyframes/waves/KF-W0.md | head -1` → *"`origin/master` package.json:77 carries `@mkbabb/glass-ui: 7.0.0` as an EXACT devDep (census SCH-1, AGG-P1), so the phantom-dependency headline is FALSIFIED at HEAD"*. Re-run at HEAD cbc201f7: that command returns `269:| **D-4** — \`AGG-P1\`, the probe that DECIDED SCH-1, absent from the wave that re-runs SCH-1 |…`. `grep -c 'phantom-dependency' keyframes/waves/KF-W0.md` → 0; `grep -n 'FALSIFIED' keyframes/waves/KF-W0.md` → only :361, a different sentence. MITIGATION: the fact is real at KF-W0.md:514 (`git show origin/master:package.json → :77 "@mkbabb/glass-ui": "7.0.0" under devDependencies`) and :522 ("**exact devDep**"), so the CONSISTENT verdict itself stands.
